module.sor.name: TSQ Sor
module.sor.description: An assistant for questions on any topic; continues a short conversation and remembers the preferences you allow: /sor, /hafizam.
cmd.sor.gizli: Only you see the answer (default: no)
cmd.sor.yeni: Start a new conversation; your memory is kept (default: no)
cmd.sor.kisi: The member your question is about (optional)
cmd.hafizam: See and manage what TSQ Sor remembers about you (only you see it).
